description_en: Query plugin information of an asset
name: ListPluginForUuid

parameters.help_en:
The UUID of the server.
You can call the [DescribeCloudCenterInstances](~~DescribeCloudCenterInstances~~) operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
服务器UUID。
调用[DescribeCloudCenterInstances](~~DescribeCloudCenterInstances~~)接口获取该参数
parameters.name: uuid

schema.description_en: The data returned by the request

AegisSuspiciousConfigList.description_en: The list of plugin configuration information

Config.description_en:
Indicates whether the plugin is enabled. Valid values:
true: enabled
false: disabled
Config.description_zh:
是否启用。取值：
true：启用
false：禁用

Msg.description_en:
The authorization binding information of the plugin. Valid values:

authorized: authorized
unauthorized: unauthorized
unbind: unbound
nonsupport: not supported
Msg.description_zh:
插件授权绑定信息。取值：

authorized：已授权
unauthorized：未授权
unbind：未绑定
nonsupport：不支持

OverallConfig.description_en:
Indicates whether this is a global configuration. Valid values:
true: yes
false: no
OverallConfig.description_zh:
是否全局配置。取值：
true：是
false：否

Type.description_en:
The name of the plugin type. Valid values:

alihips: performs virus and trojan protection
alisecguard: performs attack protection
alinet: protects against network-side attacks on the server
Type.description_zh:
插件类型名称。取值：

alihips：执行病毒木马防护功能
alisecguard：执行攻击防护功能
alinet：防护网络侧对服务器发起攻击

PluginInstallCode.description_en: The installation code of the plugin instance

PluginName.description_en:
The name of the plugin type. Valid values:

alihips: performs virus and trojan protection
alisecguard: performs attack protection
alinet: protects against network-side attacks on the server
PluginName.description_zh:
插件类型名称。取值：

alihips：执行病毒木马防护功能
alisecguard：执行攻击防护功能
alinet：防护网络侧对服务器发起攻击

PluginOnlineInstalled.description_en:
Indicates whether the plugin is installed. Valid values:
true: installed
false: not installed
PluginOnlineInstalled.description_zh:
插件是否已安装，取值：
true：已安装
false：未安装

PluginOnlineStatus.description_en:
Indicates whether the plugin is online. Valid values:
true: online
false: offline
PluginOnlineStatus.description_zh:
插件是否在线。取值：
true：在线
false：离线

Code.description_en: The result code. A value of 200 indicates success. Other values indicate failure. You can use this field to determine the cause of the failure
Code.description_zh: 结果代码，200表示成功，若为别的值则表示失败，调用方可根据此字段判断失败原因

Message.description_en: The detailed information of the error code

RequestId.description_en: The ID of this request, which is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request. It can be used for troubleshooting and problem locating
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
